notes.title: Demo Patch 0.25.04.20.09 Notes
notes.notes:
First off, Thank you all for playing the game!
This is the first of two patches that are hitting the demo before May 2nd. (Our Kickstarter Launch date)
• Gameplay Focus (This Patch)
• Performance (Next Patch)

Patch Notes

SteamDeck:
Was not correctly "latching" onto the main menu. This should be fixed

Environment:

 Some early areas in the Weapons Factory have been altered
 The beach challenge has been slightly altered due to the Movement rework (noted below)


Movement:
The entire movement kit has been revamped to address the "Floaty" feedback
I would list every change, but please refer to this meme image I've attached to the post

Combat:

 Combat has also been reworked, Armor is now working consistently with enemies again
 Combo-Strings are now using a "State Machine" which makes them feel more intentional and less spammy.
 Damage values remain the same.
 Tansy's Gauntlet weapons will now properly aim toward your Soft-Lock target instantly (no more shooting nothing)
 UpperCut was given armor break (green) if used on the 3rd punch of your combo


Camera:

 New camera that doesn't snap onto every pebble on the ground anymore (thank god)


Bugs/Misc:

 Switches can be flipped with additional attacks: Spin Attack, Upper-Cut, Down-Cutter
 Idle animation no longer plays while visiting Penny's Shop

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.25.03.28.20
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44929084/e45c351b1d70f5654fd941402d3468788a1b1b51.png
New Features

 Big-Map Screen added. View the current City Sector by pressing M on the keyboard, or the (Select, Back, Share, Minus) button on the controller.
 The map & minimap have been re-rendered to be in full color. Making it easier to tell where things are.
 Entry and Exit points on maps are marked with a yellow graphic on the map.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44929084/8335a74d7d202955a452d9bb4b4cb3bb7b5172a4.png
Ninja Kick

 Due to several player suggestions, you can now alter the trajectory of the Ninja Kick during the 8 frames of Hit-Stop.


Bug Fixes

 Load Zone code cleaned up to prevent the VERY rare de-loading of both sides
 Fixed an issue preventing tiny fences and ledges from being counted as "Grounded" preventing tansy from resetting the jump counter or Ninja Kick counter

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.25.03.16.09
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44929084/025ce5472776fca97a54d1843d03f220cf7e173f.jpg

Bug Fixes

 Walking over an Ammo Box even while at full ammo will show the weapon that would have received the ammo. (This helps remind you that you have a weapon)
 UI Buttons have all been redone
 Menus that could previously lose your gamepad "focus" have been given a fallback fix
 A very rare save file corruption bug has been fixed (Losing your weapons bug)
 The Demo build now runs in demo mode without Steam DRM


Additions

 Ninja Kick has been reworked to trigger only when intended (Floors, and Ledges) And not on random pixels from a wall
 Momentum in the game has been given a glowup, allowing for Rolling, Roll Jumping, and other actions to inherit and not cancel momentum. (Including on Conveyors)
 A new secret Outfit has been added to the game world! My only hint is "BEACH" (This is optional and does not count against 100% completion)
 Dozens of collision adjustments throughout the game to provide a more expected experience
